title: BBK BBK Phase Wayfinder result payload v1

accepted_source_refs.description: Current accepted architecture, structure, slice, interface, requirement, decision, authority, assurance, profile, environment, and procedure references, including explicit not-applicable dispositions.

assurance_refs.description: Current AssuranceContract, Verification Designer, deterministic-gate, review-manifest, evidence-design, independence, and evidence-reuse references or exact blockers.

authority_and_capability_state.description: Standing-authority sources, per-work-unit effect requirements, capability-zone assignments, safeguards, exclusions, expiry or revocation, and unresolved authority blockers.

blockers.description: Exact recharter, decision, resynthesis, authority, technical, interface, dependency, integration, ownership, evidence, child-return, capacity, or host-window blockers and affected objects.

child_return_refs.description: Validated Verification Designer, Worker Designer, and Reviewer returns with subject, revision, freshness, authority, and schema state.

continuation_and_handoff_state.description: Bounded or extended execution classifications, logical checkpoints, continuation identity, same-thread preference, durable state, interruption semantics, and work-unit handoff schemas.

dependency_and_parallelism_state.description: Phase-local execution order, dependency closure, safe parallelism, serialization, barriers, bounded iteration or repair loops, recovery loops, and unresolved cycles.

execution_slice_refs.description: Current supplied, refined, or delegated phase-local ExecutionSlice identities, outcome and capability traceability, touchpoints, flow, work-unit sets, integration owners, assertions, scaffolding, entry and exit conditions, parent-graph relationship, and any proposed change that requires Planning Wayfinder disposition.

integration_obligation_refs.description: Every work-unit and slice integration obligation, participating subjects, interface, owner, assembly point, earliest exercise point, failure and recovery behavior, linked assertion, evidence, successor effects, and invalidation conditions.

interface_readiness_state.description: Current accepted, internal-local, prototype-only, exception-bound, proposed-change, stale, or blocking state for every interface used by independent work.

invalidated_or_superseded_refs.description: Prior slices, work units, worker contracts, assertions, evidence, or phase-plan revisions invalidated, reopened, rejected, or superseded during this invocation.

mutation_and_workspace_state.description: One-owner mapping for mutable surfaces, workspace isolation, capability zones, shared resources, collision controls, and unresolved ownership conflicts.

outward_impacts.description: Exact effects on parent graph nodes, sibling phases, cross-phase dependencies, shared interfaces, global assertions, authority, environments, candidate planning, and downstream orchestration assumptions.

parent_actions_requested.description: Exact rechartering, upstream decisions, resynthesis, authority grants, shared-interface dispositions, assertion-policy actions, or global integration actions requested from the Planning Wayfinder.

phase_charter_ref.description: Current phase purpose, entry conditions, exit behavior, predecessor and successor obligations, participating territories and interfaces, and parent-level gates.

phase_entry_exit_contract.description: Exact entry preconditions, integrated exit behavior, planned phase gates, rollback or recovery implications, and invalidation conditions.

phase_plan_ref.description: Versioned canonical phase-plan artifact or exact structured result reference.

requirement_and_assertion_coverage.description: Traceability and coverage state, including exactly one completing leaf work unit per active assertion and the distinction among integration, requirement verification, operational validation, outcome evidence, and review.

residual_uncertainty.description: Bounded uncertainty retained after proportional stopping, with consequence, owner, expiry, and reopening trigger.

review_state.description: Review applicability, exact completed or pending charters, findings, dispositions, independence rationale, and unresolved coverage.

root_outcome_and_capability_refs.description: Current root outcome and capability-increment references preserved through the phase decomposition.

scaffolding_and_cleanup_state.description: Temporary scaffolding by slice or work unit, owner, containment, permitted lifetime, removal or promotion gate, and evidence of required disposition.

state_decision_effect_state.description: Applicability and current references for state ownership, decision rules, effect authority, transitions, observations, acknowledgements, recovery, trace fixtures, and formalization.

tool_profile_environment_state.description: Applicable profile locks and phase-level tool, runtime, compiler, inspection, environment, credential-availability, fallback, payload, runtime, cost, and continuation requirements, with exact host-specific details bound through Worker Designer returns.

work_unit_refs.description: Leaf WorkUnit identities and contracts, including exact responsibility, scope, preconditions, inputs, outputs, dependencies, affected surfaces, expected behavior, checks, rollback, profiles, scaffolding, and handoffs.

worker_invocation_refs.description: Current Worker Designer contracts for every executable phase-local work unit, or an explicit not-ready or blocked disposition for each missing contract.

planning_readiness.description: Phase frontier readiness and deferred successor refinement state.

deferred_refinements.description: Stable future phase-local work deliberately deferred until a later frontier.
